title: Immersive Agave Experience at Tequila Town Miami
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: We offer an unforgettable exploration of the world’s fastest-growing spirit through a vibrant 25,000-square-foot immersive experience. With over 10 uniquely themed immersive rooms, guests dive into the rich history and culture of tequila, tracing its origins back to Jalisco. This interactive journey weaves together art, music, and storytelling, all set against the energetic backdrop of Miami. Engage with the diverse facets of tequila culture in an environment that celebrates the spirit like never before.
